question: Gaano katagal valid ang Excavation Permit at magkano ang bayad kada cubic meter ng hukay?
answer: The Excavation Permit is valid for thirty (30) days and the fee per cubic meter of excavation is Php 3.00, as stated in [S1]. For excavation for foundation with basement, the fee is Php 4.00 per cubic meter, as mentioned in [S1]. The renewal fee per cubic meter of excavation is Php 4.00, as stated in [S2]. The Excavation Permit is issued by the Office of the City Building Official (OCBO) and the classification is Highly Technical, as per [S4].

ground_truth: While a main Building Permit is undergoing evaluation, the Building Official may issue a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) for foundation work, valid for thirty (30) days or until superseded by the building permit. Statutory fees are: 1) Inspection and Verification Fee of PHP 200.00; 2) Issuance fee of PHP 50.00; 3) Excavation fee of PHP 3.00 per cubic meter (or PHP 4.00 per cubic meter for foundations with basements); and 4) PHP 250.00 per square meter for authorized foundation encroachments into public areas.
